tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Free-text search across the live catalogue. Matches listing name, description, category and provider name. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing. Call tracked_url when a listing includes it. That is the URL to call. It is the PayAPI path to the provider host in base_url. base_url stays the provider address. PayAPI takes 0% and does not change who is paid.

query.description: What you are looking for, e.g. "uk property" or "sanctions screening".

verified_only.description: Restrict to settlement-verified listings. Default true.

subcategory.description: Trading and market data job. One of: market-and-price-data, derivatives-and-options, risk-and-hedging, on-chain-analytics, token-verdicts-and-signals. Omit for no extra filter. This is a keyword group, not a database category.

network.description: Only listings that accept USDC on this network: base, solana, algorand, avalanche, or a CAIP-2 id. Omit for all. Each listing reports its rails in `networks`.

tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: Browse the live catalogue, optionally filtered to one category. Omit category for everything. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing. Call tracked_url when a listing includes it. That is the URL to call. It is the PayAPI path to the provider host in base_url. base_url stays the provider address. PayAPI takes 0% and does not change who is paid.

category.description: Exact database category, or "Trading and market data" for the keyword group. That group is not stored on the row. Call with no category first to see the database categories.

subcategory.description: One job inside Trading and market data: market-and-price-data, derivatives-and-options, risk-and-hedging, on-chain-analytics, token-verdicts-and-signals. Omit for no extra filter.

network.description: Only listings that accept USDC on this network: base, solana, algorand, avalanche, or a CAIP-2 id. Omit for all. Each listing reports its rails in `networks`.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Fetch a single live listing by its id or slug, including base_url, price range, network and verification state. payment_verified is true if at least one route was paid; verified_routes names each paid route with its on-chain receipt. test_payment_usdc is the test payment, not the per-call price. amount_usdc is deprecated and has the same value; it is the verification test payment, not the price. The per-call price is price_min and price_max. Also returns a reliability object: score (0 to 100 or null), band (strong, established, thin, caution or unscored) and computed_at. Reliability is a running score from paid verifications, health history and payTo integrity, not a star rating and not a guarantee; unscored means it has not been computed for that listing yet. Method: https://payapi.market/how-an-agent-finds-payapi. Returns the listing whether or not it is verified, and reports payment_verified honestly. Free and read-only; spends nothing. Call tracked_url when a listing includes it. That is the URL to call. It is the PayAPI path to the provider host in base_url. base_url stays the provider address. PayAPI takes 0% and does not change who is paid.

id.description: Listing uuid or slug, as returned by search_apis or list_apis.

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: List one or more APIs. The minimum is a paid URL (url, paid_route_url, or urls) and contact_email (email is accepted as the same field). Price, payTo, network, description and name are read from the HTTP 402 when you omit them. Category defaults to Data, which the listing schema accepts. urls takes at most 20 routes. Each route is probed and returned in results as listed, pending or rejected, with a code and a hint when it is turned away. A no-input GET that returns a valid 402 may omit sample_input. Placeholder examples are rejected. NEVER sets payment_verified or makes the listing live. PayAPI Market may test it with a real paid call (up to $0.10 USDC on Base). Listing is free. PayAPI takes 0% of each job. Rate limited: max 10 submissions per hour per wallet and per contact email, 50 per day per IP and per payTo address. The cap still applies inside a urls array. If this wallet already submitted this API, the result is the existing listing id and the message "This API has already been submitted." No second row is created. The same wallet and email can update a listing that is still pending review.

url.description: One https route that returns HTTP 402. Use this, paid_route_url, or urls.

urls.description: Up to 20 paid routes in one call. Each is probed on its own.

name.description: API name. Read from the 402 when omitted.

description.description: API description. Read from the 402 or /.well-known/x402 when omitted.

base_url.description: Base URL of the API (https only, no localhost or tunnels). Defaults to the paid route origin.

paid_route_url.description: The exact route that requires x402 payment. Same as url.

method.description: How we call the paid route. Read from the 402 when omitted. GET uses sample_input as a query string. POST uses it as a JSON body.

price.description: Price per request in USDC. Read from the Base accept when omitted.

networks.description: Networks this API accepts (e.g. ["base"], ["base", "solana"]). The Base rail is read from the 402.

payTo.description: Base wallet that receives USDC. Read from the 402 when omitted.

contact_email.description: Contact email for the provider. Required. email is the same field.

category.description: API category. Defaults to Data when omitted. There is no Other category.

sample_input.description: Example request. A query string for GET (city=London) or a JSON body for POST ({"city":"London"}). Read from the 402 when omitted. A no-input GET with a valid 402 may leave this empty. Placeholders are rejected.

sample_url.description: Optional free sample or health URL. Called unpaid, before any paid check.

example_expected_output.description: Optional JSON shape or short sample the free check compares against.

input_param_to_vary.description: Optional parameter name to change between two free sample calls, for example city.

settles_after_success.description: Confirm the paid route settles only after a successful response. Required only when the server switch is on.

mcp_endpoint.description: Optional: MCP endpoint URL if this is an MCP server

provider_name.description: Optional: provider/company name (defaults to API name)

network.description: Only listings that accept USDC on this network: base, solana, algorand, avalanche, or a CAIP-2 id. Omit for all. Each listing reports its rails in `networks`.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search AI agents by business sector, name, or description. Agents are AI services that perform tasks like lead generation, data enrichment, or automation. Returns agents with their sector, pricing, and verified status. Free and read-only.

query.description: Search query: name, description, or sector (e.g. "real estate" or "lead generation").

sector.description: Filter by business sector: home_services, real_estate, ecommerce, marketing, sales, finance, legal, healthcare, recruiting, support, developer_tools, crypto, or other.

sort.description: Sort order: newest (default), rating (top-rated), or verified_calls (most used).
